subtitle: Being an account of what they are, and what they are not; whence they come, and whence they come not. As also how we may distinguish between the apparitions of good and evil spirits and how we ought to behave to them. With a great variety of surprizing and diverting examples, never publish'd before.
contributions: Van der Gucht, John, b. 1697, engraver.
title: An essay on the history and reality of apparitions.
